text: You're looking for a recipe that's high in fiber, and these Cranberry-Orange Muffins fit the bill. While they may not be the highest fiber content, they do contain some fiber from the whole wheat flour and cranberries, which aligns with your goal. Additionally, they're a great source of complex carbohydrates, which can help keep you full and satisfied. They're also quick to make and ready in under 30 minutes, fitting within your 60-minute time budget.
